blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Generally fair weather is expected to prevail throughout the country on Tuesday, Nov. 17, due to the continued effect of easterlies, the state weather bureau said. According to the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa), the easterlies, or warm winds coming from the Pacific Ocean, will bring partly cloudy to cloudy skies over Metro Manila and the rest of the country. “This is aside from chances of thunderstorms, especially in the afternoon until evening,” Pagasa weather specialist Veronica Torres-Bagalanon said in a morning forecast.
